note: Hand mutants of lean/VE/Arith/Bounded.lean (me-12ab). Each edit is planted alone, in the first occurrence of `before`, in a copy of Bounded.lean joined with BoundedExamples.lean and CompleteExamples.lean into one file, which `lake env lean` checks whole: Lean goes on past a broken proof, so one run lists both the proofs (`proofs`) and the #guard lines of the committed fixture files (`test`) that fail. The control (no mutant) has no error. The runner was a scratch script and is not committed. tools/trust_mutants.py selects no definition: the item adds no trusted declaration (trust +0).

seeded.bug: mono: a budget-dependent environment (a function's value adds the budget's parity)
seeded.before: fun xs w => Term.evalB E limit xs body w
seeded.after: fun xs w => (Term.evalB E limit xs body w).map fun r => (r.1 + ((limit % 2 : Nat) : Int), r.2)

seeded.bug: mono: budget 4 refuses every visit, so a larger budget loses an answer
seeded.before: if limit ≤ w then none else k (w + 1)
seeded.after: if limit ≤ w || limit = 4 then none else k (w + 1)

seeded.bug: complete: a call of a one-place predicate never completes
seeded.before: if xs.length = n then P xs w else none
seeded.after: if xs.length = n && n != 1 then P xs w else none

seeded.bug: complete's refusing side: a variable no binder gives reads 0, so an unscoped statement is decided
new definition: a completed call need only complete, not with the same value and units
seeded.before: ∀ xs w r, g xs w = some r → g' xs w = some r
seeded.after: ∀ xs w r, g xs w = some r → (g' xs w).isSome

seeded.bug: new definition: a function's work bound is strict
seeded.before: ∀ w, w + W ≤ limit → g xs w = some (x, w + W)
seeded.after: ∀ w, w + W < limit → g xs w = some (x, w + W)

seeded.bug: new definition: a free variable may be one past the outer values
new definition: a predicate body's sites are read under one binder too many
seeded.before: | .pred _ n body => ∀ s ∈ Formula.sites 0 body, s.Ok E n
seeded.after: | .pred _ n body => ∀ s ∈ Formula.sites 1 body, s.Ok E n

seeded.bug: new definition: a formula's parts are not read as its sites
